Subject: DAAD WISE Scholarship 2026 – Working Internships in Science & Engineering (Germany) – Nominations Due April 25

Dear OGE / Student Affairs Team,

Following up on our earlier communication — the DAAD (Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst, Germany's national academic exchange service) has confirmed the availability of the WISE 2026 programme for Plaksha nominees.

PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
The Working Internships in Science and Engineering (WISE) programme places undergraduate students at German universities and research institutions (RWTH Aachen, TU Munich, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, among others) for a 2–3 month paid internship over the summer. Students work in a supervised research or engineering lab and produce a final project report.

DURATION: June 15 – August 31, 2026
STIPEND: €650/month (paid directly by DAAD to the intern). Travel: €200 one-time grant. No other fees.
SEATS: Plaksha has been allocated 3 nominations this cycle.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS
- Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate engineering or science programme.
- Minimum CGPA: 8.0/10
- Must have completed at least 2 years of study (i.e., not a first-year student).
- English proficiency required; basic German is a plus but NOT mandatory.
- Applications from final-year students will not be accepted (programme is intended for students who will continue at Plaksha after the internship).
- No active backlogs at time of nomination.

HOW TO APPLY
Students submit directly to DAAD's online portal (daad.de/wise) by May 10, 2026.
However, Plaksha must first internally nominate students. Internal OGE nomination deadline: April 25, 2026.

Documents required from students:
- Updated CV (max 2 pages)
- Motivation letter (500–800 words, specific to the research area)
- Unofficial transcript
- English language proficiency evidence (IELTS/TOEFL report or a letter from the academic office confirming the medium of instruction is English)
- One academic reference letter (can be submitted after nomination)

INTERNAL APPROVAL PROCESS
All nominees must be cleared through the standard Plaksha academic review before OGE submits to DAAD.

Please coordinate with the relevant offices and confirm nominations to oge@plaksha.edu.in by April 25.

Regards,
International Partnerships Cell
Office of Global Engagement, Plaksha University
